name: save_analytics_report
description: Keep the latest report of an analytics (Markdown) in Orwick's own store (~/.orwick/analytics/<name>/report.md), where the app's Analytics screen shows it. The last step of running an analytics skill.

analytics.description: The analytics skill's name, e.g. slow-pull-requests

report.description: The report in Markdown: a first line **Result:** with the answer in one sentence, then tables, then what they mean
